_note: Four departments of a multi-speciality clinic (owner's brief, 27 Oct 2026). Each doctor maps to the departments they cover. Treatment lists inside each department are 'to confirm with the clinic' (services.json).

departments.title: Dental care
departments.line: Implants, crowns, dentures and everyday dentistry
departments.summary: Our dental side is led by two prosthodontists, the specialists who rebuild and replace teeth. Alongside implants, crowns and dentures, they look after check-ups, cleaning, fillings, root canals and children's teeth.

departments.title: Family medicine
departments.summary: Two family physicians see adults and older relatives for everyday illness, health check-ups and regular review of blood pressure and sugar, and point you to a specialist when one is needed.
departments.caution: General information only. Your doctor will advise on your own situation after examining you.

departments.title: Children's health
departments.line: Visits for babies, toddlers and school-age children
departments.summary: A doctor with paediatric training sees children for illness, growth questions and routine visits, and talks parents through what to watch for at home.
departments.caution: General information only, not a substitute for seeing a doctor. If a child is very unwell, go to the nearest emergency department.

departments.title: Eye care
departments.line: Eye checks, vision problems and referral when needed
departments.summary: An ophthalmology-trained doctor checks eyes and vision, looks at red, itchy or tired eyes, and arranges referral to a surgical centre when an operation is needed.
departments.caution: General information only. Sudden loss of vision or an eye injury needs urgent care at a hospital.
